Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery: 

1) Recap: Acme is interested in Redwood Dedicated for enterprise inference (DEAL-4821). Procurement will own the purchase route (PO vs corporate card). IT/security has asked about supplier onboarding (Coupa preferred).

2) Procurement path questions we discussed:
   - Will Acme purchase via PO (preferred for committed capacity) or via card/marketplace?
   - If PO: procurement needs Redwood's supplier details and a supplier ID in Coupa/Ariba.
   - If Marketplace: please confirm which marketplace (AWS Marketplace, Azure, GCP) so we can provide the correct listing and SKUs.

3) Docs I attached: PR_template.xlsx (PR fields we typically see), Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf (legal/tax fields), and a draft SOW to attach to the PR.

Can you confirm:
- Procurement owner & email who will raise the PR?
- Whether you prefer Coupa or Ariba for supplier setup?
- Target date to have the PR raised (goal: prior to contract signature so PO can be applied to the deal).

I can:
- Share a filled example PR (I attached the template)
- Provide Redwood vendor details (legal name, remit address, tax ID, contact for W-9)
- Coordinate with our ops team to speed supplier onboarding in Coupa/Ariba if you provide the procurement contact.

Next steps: if you confirm procurement contact and preferred platform, I’ll loop in Laura (sales ops) to open an internal ticket to provision supplier info and escalate to Coupa onboarding.

Thanks — look forward to your thoughts.

Best,

Hi Aditya — thanks for the recap. A few answers from procurement perspective: 

- Our default is to purchase via PO for platform commitments. We will not use a corporate card for multi-month committed spend.
- We use Coupa internally; supplier onboarding must go through Coupa so procurement can issue a PO.
- If Redwood is already in Coupa, please provide the Coupa supplier ID. If not, procurement will need the supplier onboarding form + W-9 and remit address.

Procurement contact is: procure@acmeretail.com (copied). The procurement team typically needs: vendor legal name, FEIN/Tax ID, remit address, primary billing contact, and a copy of the SOW or quote to attach to the PR.

Also — is Redwood listed in AWS Marketplace? If yes that can simplify AP routing, otherwise standard Coupa supplier setup is our path.

Target: aim for PR creation within 2 business days after we receive complete supplier info.

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Retail

Thanks Samantha — appreciated. Guidance below to make procurement/PR creation as painless as possible. I’ve also attached the filled example PR and the supplier onboarding form.

What we recommend (PO path / Coupa):
1) PR Owner: procurement opens a PR and attaches the SOW/quote + vendor onboarding docs (attached).
2) Supplier onboarding: If Redwood is not in Coupa, procurement should submit the Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf and request Redwood be added. If they prefer Ariba instead, same attachments apply — the fields are similar.
3) Linking supplier ID to PR: Once Coupa returns a supplier ID (example C-45219), procurement should include that supplier ID on the PR so AP can route the PO to Redwood.
4) Required PR fields (we see these commonly): cost center, GL code, start/end dates, quantity/term, total committed amount, SOW or quote attachment, account manager contact, and legal entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.). See attached PR_template.xlsx for examples.

Redwood vendor details (for procurement form):
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 120 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- FEIN/Tax ID: 37-1234567
- Primary billing contact: billing@redwood.ai

If you're interested in marketplace route: yes, Redwood has listings on AWS Marketplace (we can provide the listing link and SKU); the marketplace flow often means you do not need a separate supplier ID in Coupa, but accounting will still want the invoice routed correctly. Let me know if procurement prefers that route and I’ll provide the AWS Marketplace listing and the seller ID.

Suggested next steps:
- Procurement (procure@acmeretail.com) to confirm Coupa so Laura can open an internal ops ticket.
- Procurement to send the supplier onboarding request with our attached form.
- Once supplier ID is returned, procurement to create PR and attach SOW + quote, then share PR number with Aditya/Laura.

I’ve looped Jorge from Coupa in case procurement wants direct assistance with supplier onboarding or troubleshooting.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PR_template.xlsx (filled example), Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf
